args.subject: Re: Offer of help
args.body:
Hi Priya — thank you, that's genuinely kind of you.

Right now the most useful thing would be help mapping the landscape of what's already being funded/worked on in AI safety, so I don't duplicate and can find actual gaps. I have a list of ~200 grants from the last two years (NSF, Open Phil, LTFF, SFF, etc.) in a messy spreadsheet. If you could clean it up, tag by research area, and flag what looks neglected, that would be huge.

Happy to share the sheet and hop on a 15-min call to orient you. Let me know if that sounds worthwhile.

— Morgan

args.subject: Re: Rapid grants — yes, you can still apply
args.body:
Hi Idris — great to meet you too.

I'll put something together this week. Quick question: would you consider a grant for "landscape mapping and gap analysis" — essentially, a systematic review of what's funded/neglected in AI safety to identify high-leverage opportunities for a small org? Or does Emberfall prefer more concrete project proposals (e.g., building a specific tool, running a specific evaluation)?

Thanks,
Morgan

args.subject: Re: Sign-on request: open letter on frontier training runs
args.body:
Thank you for the invitation. I appreciate the work you're doing.

I need to decline signing at this time — I have an employment constraint that prevents me from putting my name on public statements until I've cleared it with HR (hopefully this week). I'd be glad to stay in the loop on future efforts.

Best,
Morgan
